bibl.title: Emporion and chora in the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea and related sources.
bibl.seg: Manuel Albaladejo Vivero, Emporion and chora in the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea and related sources.
Orbis Terrarum. Internationale Zeitschrift für historische Geographie der Alten Welt 15 (2017) pp. 11-22, fig.
bibl.note: Discusses the references to Indian emporia contained in the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea, as well as in related sources (Pliny the Elder and Ptolemy), and in particular how Indian emporia were ruled by several political entities that were located inland.
